output.reason: [ev-602e50572fe9] gives only a one-line title, but the linked PR [ev-f63f86a64ca6] explains the change. When a new app is requested for creation, argocd server runs a manifest-generation (validation) call through repo-server, and that call is cached. Before the fix, the server did not set appLabelKey (or VerifySignature), so the app-controller's later calls for the same manifests, which do set appLabelKey, missed the cache. Now the server sets them so the cached result can be reused. That covers the open aspects: exposure is any installation where apps are created through argocd server (one file, util/argo/argo.go, per [ev-19286a988a1c]), and the consequence is a performance/cache-efficiency gain (fewer redundant manifest generations), not a functional break, so operators need to do nothing.
